findings.issue_text: [ADVISORY] Adoption bypasses the verdict-aware same-head rule: a chained run C at an unchanged head that chains from a same-diff throwaway run B also adopts a separate blocking standalone run S, so S's findings are superseded and closed if C does not re-derive them. No concrete gate bypass was constructed: pr-ready findings are recomputed from live inputs each run, and lens/FSM findings carry their own run IDs. A pr-ready-owned finding that is not deterministically re-derived could close with no code change.

[ADVISORY] Same-diff adoption keys only on base SHA and head SHA, so an earlier standalone run over that head with a different working-tree state or mutation view is adopted as the same review. A chained run could close findings from that other run's uncommitted or view-specific changes that it never re-examined. Code-read only, not reproduced.
